# Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)

Every architecture or design decision is in a separate file (see ADR-0001).
New ADR: copy `docs/adr/0000-template.md`, assign the next free number, then run
`cargo xtask docs --fix`. This updates the table below automatically.

Status: `proposed` → `accepted` → (`superseded` | `rejected`).
Accepted ADRs are not rewritten but superseded by a new ADR.
